hook.name: HatTrickHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 afterSwap hook for a $HAT/WETH pool that captures a configurable BPS fee on each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, then splits it three ways: to a prize vault, burned (directly for HAT fees or deferred via buybackAndBurn() for WETH fees), and to a treasury address. Fee rate and split ratios are owner-configurable within set bounds.
